turns.text: what am i supposed to put in keyMaterial when requesting health information as HIU

must_contain: Before the call, generate an ECDH key pair on Curve25519 and a 32 byte nonce, and send the public key and nonce in keyMaterial.
keyValue is the public key, Base64 encoded, in X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo form.
notes: The keyMaterial block is where M3 builds stall. Distinct from faq-verbatim-sandbox-m3-04 and -05, which cover who stores and who sends keys, not the curve or the key encoding. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m3-hiu-health-information-request.md, 'Before the call, generate an [ECDH] key pair on `Curve25519` and a 32 byte nonce. Send the public key and nonce in `keyMaterial`'; same file, '`keyValue` is the public key, Base64 encoded, in X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo form.'
